rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for security, steadfastness, or a securely held object.

example.english: Only after checking the bridge’s firmness did everyone feel reassured.
example.traditional: 檢查完呢座橋嘅穩固性，大家先至放心。
example.jyutping: gim2 caa4 jyun4 ne1 zo6 kiu4 ge3 wan2 gu3 sing3 daai6 gaa1 sin1 zi3 fong3 sam1

rows.note: Use this for firmness as resolve or determination rather than physical firmness.

example.english: Their firmness was clear: they kept going no matter how hard it got.
example.traditional: 佢落咗決心，無論幾辛苦都會行落去。
example.jyutping: keoi5 lok6 zo2 kyut3 sam1 mou4 leon6 gei2 san1 fu2 dou1 wui5 haang4 lok6 heoi3

rows.note: Use this for the measurable hardness or rigidity of a material.

example.english: The firmness of this rubber is just right; it isn’t too hard.
example.traditional: 呢種膠嘅硬度啱啱好，唔會太硬。
example.jyutping: ne1 zung2 gaau1 ge3 ngaang6 dou6 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2 m4 wui5 taai3 ngaang6
